convo.travel.excursion.plan_exchange.rep: Alright, {addressee.name}. Pack light, keep the crowbar handy, and we stick to the side streets.
Roads looked quiet earlier {scene.location}, {addressee.name}, though there's always a few stragglers near the gas station.
Better to wait for first light. Fog's too thick out by the highway right now.
Hold off moving out until the storm breaks and visibility clears.
No sense going out there right now. Stay put until it's safe.
I don't love the odds on that road, {addressee.name}, though I'll tag along carefully.
I'll run that stretch only if we bring a second gun along for cover.
Take the service alley west instead—avoids the ambush stretch completely.
convo.travel.excursion.plan_exchange.say: We're running low on canned goods and spare batteries, {addressee.name}. Think we can make a quick run {scene.location}?
